newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea sees $21.5 bln c/a deficit for 1996.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea sees $21.5 bln c/a deficit for 1996.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea was revising upward its projection for this year's current account deficit to about $21.5 billion from an earlier forecast of about $20 billion, a central bank official said.
The deficit for calendar 1995 was $8.95 billion, compared with a $4.53 billion shortfall in 1994.

"We have a current account deficit of $19.5 billion during the first 10 months of this year. It looks like we will have about $2 billion more in November and December," said Paeng Dong-joon, director of the central bank's statistics division.
The deficit was $8.42 billion in the first 10 months of 1995, the central bank said.
